body: Hi! This is Laura from the clinic, just saved this number. Is this the right WhatsApp for orders from now on?
Good morning team, hope you all had a nice weekend :)
Hello, I'm the new purchasing manager at the residence, replacing Carmen. Nice to meet you, I'll be your contact from today.
Hi Ana, happy Friday! Thanks for all the help this week
Hey, just wanted to say hello and wish you a great summer break. Talk in September!
Good afternoon! Pharmacy here, testing this number. Please reply when you see it
Hello hello, Merry Christmas and happy new year to everyone at the warehouse!
Morning! Back from holidays today, will be in touch soon
Hi, this is Jorge from the clinic reception. Our director asked me to say thanks for the quick service last month.
hello :) all good on our side, have a nice day
Hi there, new phone so new number for me. Please save it under the clinic name. Thanks!
Hi, quick question: what time does the driver usually arrive on Tuesdays?
Hello, do you still sell the compression stockings class II or only class I? Just asking, not ordering yet
Can you send me the updated price list for this quarter please?
Good morning, is the warehouse open on the bank holiday next Monday?
Hi, could you tell me if my last invoice has already been paid? Accounts says they sent the transfer
Hello, what is the minimum amount for free delivery?
Do you have a catalogue in PDF? Our new nurse wants to see what you carry before we place anything
Hi again, what's the email for sending purchase orders, is it the same as before?
Quick one: are your nitrile gloves latex free certified? A patient asked us
Hello, how long does delivery to the islands take usually?
Hi, can we change the delivery address on our account? We are moving next month. Who should I talk to?
Hi, yesterday's delivery arrived with two boxes crushed and wet. Very disappointed, can someone call me?
Hello, the invoice you sent us has the wrong VAT number again. Third time this happens!!
The driver left the parcel outside the door in the rain and nobody rang. Not acceptable
hi, we are still waiting for last week's order, it was supposed to arrive monday. what is going on?
Good morning. The masks we received are not the ones we usually get, the elastic breaks easily. Not happy with the quality
Hello, we were charged twice for the same order this month. Please check and refund
Nobody answers the phone in the afternoons, I tried four times today. Really frustrating
Hi, the gloves in the last box had a strong smell and several were torn. We had to throw them away
Delivery came without the packing slip and half the items were missing from the box. Please sort this out
I'm writing to complain about the courier, he was very rude to our receptionist this morning.
